scope: Only preserved original fields are copied; stale checkpoint status/actions are not used as current outcomes.

requirements.title: Measure foreground evidence submission cost
requirements.original_acceptance: Attribute full payload copies/JSON before response, queue admission, native receipt validation and rejected work; use maximum envelopes.

requirements.title: Use bounded compact evidence before queue admission
requirements.original_acceptance: Avoid unnecessary full payload copying; preserve correlation/attempt identity and explicit aggregate degraded counters.

requirements.title: Define persistence milestones and loss window
requirements.original_acceptance: Document memory accepted versus journal durable versus DB committed; specify deduplication, crash cut points and single-writer ownership.

requirements.title: Implement real SQL transaction batching
requirements.original_acceptance: Group inserts within bounded latency/size limits; preserve uniqueness and per-record outcomes without silently changing durability promises.

requirements.title: Replace per-record whole-journal rewrites
requirements.original_acceptance: Use bounded checkpoint/segment compaction or equivalent; keep exact replay and sidecar consistency under crash and backlog.

requirements.title: Exercise persistence fault recovery
requirements.original_acceptance: Test duplicate IDs, SQLite busy/corrupt, read-only/full disk, truncated journal and death at append/commit/checkpoint; decisions must not be rerun.

requirements.title: Qualify real receipt ingestion under mixed load
requirements.original_acceptance: Drive actual native receipts alongside mixed pre/post hooks and policy updates; report fsyncs, bytes rewritten, queue age and process-tree resources.

requirements.title: Verify evidence privacy and truthful status
requirements.original_acceptance: Probe exported metrics, error paths and receipts for raw secrets, commands, output and private paths; separate availability continuations from evaluated allows.
